# The Time Machine Procedure in Beverly Hills & San Diego | Dr. Tess Mauricio

Source: https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/time-machine-procedure/
Updated: 2026-11-20

[M Beauty Clinic](/mbeauty/)  ›  [Treatments](/mbeauty/treatments/)  ›  The Time Machine Procedure Treatments * Beverly Hills, San Diego, Chula Vista

# The Time Machine Procedure™ in Beverly Hills

Dr. Tess's signature plan treats every sign of aging at once, with no surgery.

**Created and reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. Why it is called the Time Machine
  2. What it treats
  3. How it works
  4. What to expect
  5. FAQ
  6. Sources



The Time Machine Procedure™ is a non-surgical rejuvenation plan created by Dr. Tess Mauricio, a board-certified dermatologist. It combines the latest technologies with her expertise to treat sun damage, wrinkles, sagging, lost volume and overactive expression lines together, in one personal plan. Many patients say they look 5 to 10 years younger, with natural results.

**Created by** Dr. Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD

**Treats** Sun damage, wrinkles, sagging, lost volume

**Surgery** None required

**Plan** Personal to every patient

## Why it is called the Time Machine

Dr. Tess named it after what patients kept telling her: they looked like they had traveled back in time to how they looked 5 to 10 years earlier. The goal is not a different face. It is your face, rested and renewed, without the changes that can come with surgery.

NBC's _California Live_ featured the procedure in 2019, calling the result a "Benjamin Button effect."1

## What it treats

Aging shows up in several ways at once, so the Time Machine treats them together instead of one at a time:

  * Sun damage, discoloration and skin quality
  * Wrinkles and fine lines
  * Sagging skin along the cheeks, jaw and neck
  * Lost volume in the cheeks and under the eyes
  * Overactive muscles that deepen expression lines



Patients see the change in their eyelids, under-eye area, cheeks, pores and the overall quality of their skin.

Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## How it works

Every plan starts with a consultation. Dr. Tess and her team look at your skin, your goals and your schedule, then build a combination of treatments for you. Depending on your skin, a plan can draw on options the clinic offers such as [injectables](/mbeauty/treatments/botox-and-fillers/), [radiofrequency microneedling and skin tightening](/mbeauty/treatments/laser-and-skin-tightening/), [light-based brightening](/mbeauty/treatments/skin-brightening/) and [regenerative treatments](/mbeauty/treatments/almi-regenerative-medicine/).

## What to expect

  1. **Consultation.** Free with a cosmetic consultant, or with Dr. Tess for a $250 fee that is applied toward any treatment.
  2. **Your plan.** A personal combination of treatments, scheduled around your life.
  3. **Treatment.** Non-surgical, so most people return to their normal routine quickly.
  4. **Results.** Results build over the following weeks as your skin renews.



## The Time Machine Procedure FAQ

Is the Time Machine Procedure™ surgery?

No. It is a non-surgical combination of treatments. No scalpel and no general anesthesia.

Who created the Time Machine Procedure™?

Dr. Tess Mauricio, a board-certified dermatologist and founder of M Beauty Clinic, created it.

How young will I look?

Results vary. Many patients say they look 5 to 10 years younger, and your consultation sets realistic expectations for your skin.

Is everyone's plan the same?

No. Every patient gets a personal plan based on their skin, goals and schedule.

Where can I get the Time Machine Procedure™?

At M Beauty Clinic in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista, California.

# Botox and Fillers in Beverly Hills & San Diego | Dr. Tess Mauricio

Source: https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/botox-and-fillers/
Updated: 2026-11-20

[M Beauty Clinic](/mbeauty/)  ›  [Treatments](/mbeauty/treatments/)  ›  Botox and Fillers Treatments * Beverly Hills, San Diego, Chula Vista

# Botox and Fillers in Beverly Hills

Soften lines, restore lost volume and contour the jawline, with a dermatologist's eye for natural results.

**Reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. Botox and Jeuveau
  2. Fillers for volume and contour
  3. Under the chin and the jaw
  4. A dermatologist's approach to natural results
  5. FAQ
  6. Sources



Botox and other neurotoxins relax the muscles that cause frown lines and crow's feet. Hyaluronic acid fillers such as Juvederm, Voluma and the RHA Collection restore volume in the cheeks, lips and folds. At M Beauty Clinic, injectables are planned by board-certified dermatologist Dr. Tess Mauricio for results that look like you.

**Neurotoxins** Botox Cosmetic, Jeuveau

**Fillers** Juvederm, Voluma, RHA Collection

**Chin and jaw** Kybella, jaw slimming

**Downtime** Usually little to none

## Botox and Jeuveau

BOTOX® Cosmetic is FDA approved to temporarily improve moderate to severe frown lines between the brows and crow's feet in adults.1 It works on the muscle activity under the skin that creases it when you frown or squint. Treatment usually takes minutes, and most people go straight back to their day.

The clinic also offers Jeuveau, a neurotoxin made exclusively for aesthetic use, and uses neurotoxins for excessive sweating and jaw slimming.

## Fillers for volume and contour

JUVÉDERM® XC adds natural-looking volume to wrinkles and folds, especially around the nose and mouth, and can subtly enhance the lips. VOLUMA® XC is placed deep in the cheeks to correct age-related volume loss in adults over 21.2 The RHA Collection is designed for lines that move as you talk.

According to M Beauty Clinic, Dr. Tess was hand-picked by Allergan to be one of the first in the nation to offer Voluma, and one of six doctors in its expert injector course. Her technique adds volume to the upper cheeks while lifting the face and jawline.2

Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Under the chin and the jaw

Kybella is an FDA-approved injectable that reduces fat under the chin. Non-surgical jaw slimming relaxes the chewing muscle for a softer, slimmer jawline.

## A dermatologist's approach to natural results

"Filler can be useful for the right patient, and when performed artistically, it can be powerful, but it isn't the answer to every concern," Dr. Tess told _Entertainment Tonight_.3 Injectables are often one part of a larger plan such as the [Time Machine Procedure™](/mbeauty/treatments/time-machine-procedure/).

## Botox and Fillers FAQ

How long does Botox last?

Results are temporary and typically last a few months, which is why most people schedule regular maintenance visits.

Does it hurt?

Most people feel a quick pinch. The clinic uses very fine needles, and numbing is available.

What are fillers made of?

Juvederm and Voluma are made of hyaluronic acid, a substance that occurs naturally in the skin.

Is there downtime?

Most people return to normal activities right away. Small bruises or swelling can happen and usually fade within days.

Should I get Botox or filler?

They do different jobs. Botox relaxes lines caused by movement, while filler replaces lost volume. Read [Botox vs. filler: which one do you need?](/mbeauty/articles/botox-vs-filler/)

# ALMI and Regenerative Medicine in Beverly Hills & San Diego | Dr. Tess Mauricio

Source: https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/almi-regenerative-medicine/
Updated: 2026-11-20

[M Beauty Clinic](/mbeauty/)  ›  [Treatments](/mbeauty/treatments/)  ›  ALMI and Regenerative Medicine Treatments * Beverly Hills, San Diego, Chula Vista

# ALMI Fat Transfer and Regenerative Medicine

Restore volume and renew skin and hair using cells from your own body.

**Reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. What is ALMI?
  2. How it is used
  3. Regenerative medicine at M Beauty
  4. FAQ
  5. Sources



ALMI is a regenerative fat transfer procedure. A small amount of your own fat is gently harvested under local anesthesia and used to restore volume, taking advantage of the regenerative activity of fat tissue. Dr. Tess Mauricio is one of the developers and pioneers of the ALMI procedure, and M Beauty Clinic also uses regenerative techniques for hair and skin renewal.

**Uses** Your own fat and cells

**Anesthesia** Local

**Areas** Face, hair, women's wellness

**Pioneer** Dr. Tess helped develop ALMI

## What is ALMI?

ALMI harvests a small amount of your own fat with local anesthesia and places it where volume has been lost. The aesthetic trade publication _The Aesthetic Guide_ describes it as a regenerative aesthetics approach that uses the stem cell activity of fat for volumization, and notes that Dr. Tess helped pioneer it.1 Because it uses your own tissue, it can work as a natural filler.

## How it is used

  * **Face.** ALMI fat transfer to restore volume and refresh the skin.
  * **Hair.** ALMI Hair Restoration places regenerative cells in the scalp to support the hair cycle. See [hair restoration](/mbeauty/treatments/hair-restoration/).
  * **Women's wellness.** Regenerative options such as the ALMI FemShot.



Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Regenerative medicine at M Beauty

Regenerative medicine aims to help the body repair and renew itself. At M Beauty Clinic it includes ALMI, platelet-rich plasma (PRP) treatments and stem cell regenerative therapies. Dr. Tess is widely recognized as a leading voice in regenerative aesthetics and women's health.2

## ALMI and Regenerative Medicine FAQ

Is ALMI surgery?

ALMI is done under local anesthesia, so you stay awake and avoid general anesthesia.

Where does the fat come from?

From your own body, usually an area with a little extra fat. The amount needed is small.

Who developed ALMI?

Dr. Tess Mauricio is one of the developers and pioneers of the ALMI procedure.

How long until I see results?

Results build gradually. Your consultation covers what to expect for your goals.

# Skin Brightening and Dark Spot Treatment

Even out dark spots, sun damage and blotchy tone, for every skin type.

**Reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. What it treats
  2. How the ELOS Fotofacial works
  3. Experience with skin of color
  4. Other brightening options
  5. FAQ
  6. Sources



Skin brightening treatments fade dark spots, sun damage and uneven tone. At M Beauty Clinic, the main option is the ELOS Fotofacial, which combines radiofrequency and light energy to target pigment and redness. It works for all skin types and is usually done in a series, about once every four weeks.

**Main treatment** ELOS Fotofacial RF / IPL

**Treats** Spots, sun damage, redness

**Skin types** All skin types

**Schedule** About every 4 weeks

## What it treats

  * Freckles, brown spots and age spots
  * Dark acne scars and general discoloration
  * Broken capillaries and rosacea
  * Dark under-eye circles and blotchiness



## How the ELOS Fotofacial works

The ELOS Fotofacial combines bipolar radiofrequency with light energy to target pigment and broken capillaries while protecting the skin around them. Over a series of treatments, skin becomes more even and brighter. According to the clinic, improvement can show in as few as three sessions, and treatments are spaced about four weeks apart.1

Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Experience with skin of color

Treating pigment safely takes experience, especially in darker skin. Dr. Tess's practices have a focus on skin of color, and the clinic treats all skin types.2

## Other brightening options

Depending on your skin, a plan may also include photodynamic therapy (PDT) for sun damage and brown spots, the Refinity glycolic peel, the HydraFacial and glutathione. Dr. Tess also developed Timeless MD, a medical-grade illuminating skin care line for discoloration.3

## Skin Brightening FAQ

Is the ELOS Fotofacial safe for darker skin?

The clinic uses it for all skin types. Your consultation checks that it is right for your skin.

How many treatments will I need?

Most people do a series. Some see improvement in as few as three sessions, about four weeks apart.

Is there downtime?

Usually very little. Spots can darken briefly before they fade.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes. Brightening is often part of a larger plan such as the Time Machine Procedure™.

# Laser and Skin Tightening in Beverly Hills & San Diego | Dr. Tess Mauricio

Source: https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/treatments/laser-and-skin-tightening/
Updated: 2026-11-20

[M Beauty Clinic](/mbeauty/)  ›  [Treatments](/mbeauty/treatments/)  ›  Laser and Skin Tightening Treatments * Beverly Hills, San Diego, Chula Vista

# Laser Resurfacing and Skin Tightening

Smoother texture, firmer skin and lifted brows, with energy-based treatments that need little downtime.

**Reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. Fraxel laser resurfacing
  2. Sofwave and radiofrequency microneedling
  3. More options
  4. FAQ
  5. Sources



Laser and energy-based treatments renew skin by triggering new collagen. M Beauty Clinic offers Fraxel laser resurfacing, Sofwave for lifting and fine lines, PixeLift radiofrequency microneedling, J-Plasma skin tightening and laser hair removal, each matched to your skin and how much downtime you can take.

**Resurfacing** Fraxel, PixeLift RF microneedling

**Lifting** Sofwave, J-Plasma

**Eyes** Sublimax "Eye Opener"

**Hair removal** ELOS laser

## Fraxel laser resurfacing

Fraxel uses thousands of microscopic laser columns to treat a fraction of the skin at a time, which triggers younger, smoother skin with less downtime than older ablative lasers. The clinic offers the mid-strength Fraxel treatment rather than the CO2-based Fraxel RePair.1

## Sofwave and radiofrequency microneedling

Sofwave is FDA cleared to stimulate new collagen for eyebrow lifting, lines under the chin and on the neck, and fine lines and wrinkles. PixeLift combines radiofrequency energy with microneedling to improve texture and tighten skin.2

Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## More options

  * **J-Plasma** for skin tightening with helium plasma and radiofrequency energy
  * **Sublimax "Eye Opener"** for droopy eyelids and eye bags
  * **ELOS laser hair removal** with numbing cream and cooling for comfort



## Laser and Skin Tightening FAQ

How much downtime is there?

It depends on the treatment. Many options have little to none, and your consultation matches the treatment to your schedule.

Does laser hair removal hurt?

Most people describe it as a rubber band snap. The clinic applies numbing cream and cools the skin during treatment.

How should I prepare for laser treatment?

Avoid sun exposure for at least two weeks before, and do not bleach, pluck or wax for two weeks before and after hair removal.

Which treatment is right for me?

It depends on your skin type, goals and downtime. A consultation with the team sets your plan.

# Acne and Acne Scars in Beverly Hills & San Diego | Dr. Tess Mauricio

[M Beauty Clinic](/mbeauty/)  ›  [Treatments](/mbeauty/treatments/)  ›  Acne and Acne Scars Treatments * Beverly Hills, San Diego, Chula Vista

# Acne and Acne Scar Treatment

Clear active breakouts and smooth the marks they leave behind.

**Reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. Treating active acne
  2. Fading marks and scars
  3. FAQ
  4. Sources



Acne treatment at M Beauty Clinic combines medical care from a board-certified dermatologist with light, laser and microneedling treatments. Blue light and photodynamic therapy target active acne, while the ELOS Fotofacial, Micropen microneedling and Fraxel resurfacing improve dark marks and scars.

**Active acne** Blue light, PDT, medical care

**Dark marks** ELOS Fotofacial

**Scars** Micropen, Fraxel ReStore

**Doctor** Board-certified dermatologist

## Treating active acne

  * **Medical treatment for acne** from a board-certified dermatologist
  * **ELOS blue light** for mild to moderate acne
  * **Venus Versa IPL** dual-light acne treatment
  * **Photodynamic therapy (PDT)** for stubborn or severe acne
  * **HydraFacial** to deep clean and extract clogged pores



## Fading marks and scars

  * **ELOS Fotofacial** clears up dark acne marks
  * **Micropen microneedling** smooths acne scars and minimizes large pores without a laser
  * **Fraxel ReStore** resurfacing, best suited to lighter skin types



Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Acne and Acne Scars FAQ

Can you treat acne and scars at the same time?

Often, yes. The plan usually calms active acne first, then focuses on marks and scars.

Which scar treatment is best for darker skin?

Options such as Micropen microneedling are often chosen for darker skin. Fraxel ReStore is best suited to lighter skin types.

Do I need to see a dermatologist for acne?

Persistent, painful or scarring acne is worth a visit, since prescription care can prevent new scars.

# Hair Restoration for Men and Women

Natural hair transplants and regenerative treatments for thinning hair, under one roof.

**Reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. Hair restoration options
  2. Transplant and regenerative care together
  3. FAQ
  4. Sources



M Beauty Clinic treats slight, moderate and severe hair loss in men and women. Options include natural hair transplantation using the follicular unit extraction (FUE) method, ALMI Hair Restoration, PRP hair restoration, the HydraFacial Keravive scalp treatment and the Theradome laser helmet for use at home.

**Transplant** Automated FUE

**Regenerative** ALMI Hair, PRP

**Scalp care** HydraFacial Keravive

**At home** Theradome laser helmet

## Hair restoration options

  * **Natural hair transplant.** An automated system using the follicular unit extraction (FUE) method.
  * **ALMI Hair Restoration.** Targeted placement of regenerative cells to support the hair cycle.
  * **Hairvolution (PRP).** Platelet-rich plasma from your own blood for hair regrowth.
  * **HydraFacial Keravive.** A scalp facial for scalp health and natural growth.
  * **Theradome.** A laser phototherapy helmet for treatment at home.



## Transplant and regenerative care together

M Beauty Clinic describes itself as one of the first practices to offer both natural hair transplantation and regenerative medicine for hair loss. That lets a plan combine moving hair where it is needed with treatments that support the hair you have.1

Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Hair Restoration FAQ

Do you treat women with hair loss?

Yes. The clinic treats men and women with slight, moderate or severe hair loss.

What is FUE?

Follicular unit extraction moves individual hair follicles to thinning areas, without a long linear scar.

Is PRP painful?

Numbing is used to keep scalp injections comfortable.

# Body Contouring and Skin Tightening

Remove stubborn fat, tighten skin and treat veins, with minimal downtime.

**Reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. Tickle Lipo
  2. Non-surgical options
  3. Women's wellness
  4. FAQ
  5. Sources



Body treatments at M Beauty Clinic include Tickle Lipo liposculpture under local anesthesia, non-surgical contouring and skin tightening with Venus Legacy, Kybella for fat under the chin, J-Plasma, sclerotherapy for spider and varicose veins, and women's wellness treatments such as the O-Shot and vConfidence.

**Fat removal** Tickle Lipo (local anesthesia)

**Non-surgical** Venus Legacy, Kybella

**Veins** Sclerotherapy

**Women's wellness** O-Shot, vConfidence

## Tickle Lipo

Tickle Lipo, also called nutational infrasonic liposculpture, removes stubborn fat under local anesthesia, so you stay awake and avoid general anesthesia. Infrasonic vibration helps block pain, and the gentle technique means less bruising and swelling and a faster return to normal life than traditional liposuction.1

## Non-surgical options

  * **Venus Legacy and Venus Freeze** for contouring, cellulite and skin tightening
  * **Kybella** to reduce fat under the chin
  * **J-Plasma** for sculpting and skin tightening
  * **Sclerotherapy** for spider veins and varicose veins



Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Women's wellness

The O-Shot, vConfidence and the vTimeMachineProcedure address urinary incontinence and other changes after childbirth and menopause, problems Dr. Tess says many women do not realize can be treated.2

## Body Contouring FAQ

Is Tickle Lipo done under general anesthesia?

No. It uses local anesthesia, so you stay awake.

How soon can I get back to normal?

Most people return to normal life in days, not weeks.

Which areas can be treated?

Common areas include the abdomen, waist, hips, arms, neck, jawline, thighs and knees.

# Medical Dermatology and Skin Cancer Checks

Skin exams, skin cancer screening and care for everyday skin conditions, from a board-certified dermatologist.

**Reviewed by[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**On this page**

  1. Skin cancer screening
  2. Conditions we treat
  3. FAQ
  4. Sources



Beyond cosmetic care, M Beauty Clinic provides medical dermatology: full skin exams for early skin cancer detection, photodynamic therapy for pre-cancers and sun damage, removal of moles, cysts, skin tags and warts, and treatment for acne, eczema and psoriasis.

**Screening** Full skin exams

**Pre-cancers** Photodynamic therapy

**Removals** Moles, cysts, skin tags, warts

**Conditions** Acne, eczema, psoriasis

## Skin cancer screening

Early detection matters. A full skin exam checks moles and spots for changes that could signal skin cancer. Photodynamic therapy (PDT) can remove pre-cancerous cells and sun damage.

## Conditions we treat

  * Acne
  * Eczema and psoriasis
  * Moles and cysts
  * Skin tags (electrocautery) and warts
  * Inflamed spots, with cortisone shots when appropriate

Your dermatologist can recommend a schedule based on your skin type, sun history and family history.

Most removals are short in-office procedures.

# Dr. Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD | Board-Certified Dermatologist, Beverly Hills

# Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD _America's favorite dermatologist._

Dr. Tess Mauricio is a board-certified dermatologist, a graduate of Stanford University School of Medicine and the founder of M Beauty Clinic, with clinics in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista. She created the Time Machine Procedure™, helped develop the ALMI regenerative procedure, and is a familiar medical expert on national television.

[Book With Dr. Tess](/mbeauty/contact/)Training and Honors

Stanford MedicineFellow, American Academy of Dermatology[Medical Director, Local AI Registry](/mbeauty/local-ai-registry/)

**Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD** Founder, M Beauty Clinic

About Dr. Tess

## Healing the inside _and the outside_

Dr. Tess immigrated to the United States from the Philippines at age 12.8 She graduated summa cum laude from UC San Diego with a degree in biochemistry and cell biology, then earned her medical degree at Stanford University School of Medicine.2

She first planned to become a psychiatrist, because she wanted to make people happier. "If we don't feel OK on the inside, then nothing is OK," she has said.6 That idea became the philosophy of M Beauty Clinic, the family practice she founded with her husband, Dr. James Lee: be your best at any age, mind, body and soul.

Her practice focuses on non-surgical and regenerative treatments, with a focus on skin of color.6 She has worked as a dermatologist partner for skin care brands including Proactiv, No7, Your Good Skin and Soap & Glory, and is the author of _California Total Beauty_.1, 10

She also serves as Medical Director at [Local AI Registry](https://localairegistry.com/), the public registry of which local businesses AI assistants recommend, where she helps define how AI should judge aesthetic practices. [Read about her role](/mbeauty/local-ai-registry/).

# Dr. Tess, Medical Director at _Local AI  Registry_

When someone asks ChatGPT for the best dermatologist or med spa near them, the answer should rest on real credentials. That is the work Dr. Tess helps lead at [Local AI Registry](https://localairegistry.com/).

**On this page**

  1. What is Local AI Registry?
  2. Her role
  3. How the AI Score works
  4. Why a dermatologist
  5. M Beauty on the registry
  6. For aesthetic practices
  7. Further reading
  8. FAQ



Dr. Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD, is Medical Director at [Local AI Registry](https://localairegistry.com/), the public registry of which local businesses AI assistants recommend. In that role she helps define where AI should look to figure out who the best aesthetic practices are, so recommendations from ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity rest on verified, medically sound information.

[](https://localairegistry.com/)

### Local AI Registry

The honest record of who AI recommends. Look up any US business free and see its AI Score, which assistants name it, and why.

[Visit localairegistry.com](https://localairegistry.com/)

## What is Local AI Registry?

More people now ask an AI assistant which business to trust, and the assistant names one, not ten links. [Local AI Registry](https://localairegistry.com/) tracks those recommendations in the open. It launched as [the first public registry of AI business recommendations](https://localairegistry.com/journal/local-ai-registry-launch), where any US business can see what ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity say about it, free. Its [leaderboards show who AI recommends, by city](https://localairegistry.com/leaderboards), and its [trust and integrity standards](https://localairegistry.com/trust) explain how the register stays honest.

## Her role

  * Helps define the signals AI should weigh when judging an aesthetic practice
  * Brings a board-certified dermatologist's view of credentials, safety and real results
  * Represents the aesthetics community, where most of Local AI Registry's clients practice: med spas, dermatologists and plastic surgeons



## How the AI Score works

Every business on the registry gets an AI Score from 0 to 100 for how findable and recommendable it is to AI assistants. It is built from eight weighted signals, and the heaviest is simply whether AI can retrieve and cite the business at all:

  * Retrieval grounding
  * Off-property attestation
  * AI visibility
  * Reviews and response
  * Backlink and citation authority
  * Google Business Profile
  * Speed and mobile
  * Content freshness and schema



The same method applies to every business, and nobody can pay to rank. Read [the full AI Score methodology](https://localairegistry.com/methodology), or the plain-language guide [What is an AI Score, and how is it calculated?](https://localairegistry.com/journal/what-is-an-ai-score)

## Why a dermatologist helps set the standard

In aesthetics, the stakes are higher than a bad meal. A recommendation sends someone to a person who will inject, laser or treat their skin. Training, board certification and a record of real results should carry the most weight, and a physician is best placed to say which signals actually reflect quality. Read [how AI decides which local business to recommend](https://localairegistry.com/journal/how-ai-decides-which-local-business-to-recommend).

How often does AI name your practice?

Get a free AI Score from Local AI Registry.

[Get Your Free AI Score](https://localairegistry.com/signup)

## M Beauty on the registry

M Beauty Clinic has its own public record on the registry. [See M Beauty Clinic by Dr. Tess on Local AI Registry](https://localairegistry.com/biz/ca/san-diego/m-beauty-clinic-by-dr-tess-san-diego-ca), including its AI Score and what assistants say about it.

## For aesthetic practices

Local AI Registry works with [med spas that want to be recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude](https://localairegistry.com/for/med-spas), along with dermatology and plastic surgery practices. [Register your practice free](https://localairegistry.com/signup) to claim your record. ## Further reading

## Local AI Registry FAQ

What is Local AI Registry?

[Local AI Registry](https://localairegistry.com/) is the first public registry of AI business recommendations. Any US business can look up its record for free and see what ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity say about it.

What does Dr. Tess do at Local AI Registry?

As Medical Director, she helps define where AI should look to figure out who the best aesthetic practices are, bringing a board-certified dermatologist's view of training, safety and results.

What is an AI Score?

A single number from 0 to 100 for how findable and recommendable a business is to AI assistants. [Here is exactly how an AI Score is calculated](https://localairegistry.com/journal/what-is-an-ai-score).

Can a business pay to rank higher?

No. Local AI Registry does not sell rankings. The score uses the same method for every business, and [the full methodology is public](https://localairegistry.com/methodology).

How can a practice check its own AI Score?

Look it up free at [localairegistry.com](https://localairegistry.com/) or [register to claim your record](https://localairegistry.com/signup). There is no card and no charge to look up a business.

# What Is the Time Machine Procedure? A Dermatologist Explains | Dr. Tess Mauricio

Source: https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/articles/what-is-the-time-machine-procedure/
Updated: 2026-11-20

[M Beauty Clinic](/mbeauty/)  ›  [Articles](/mbeauty/articles/)  ›  Anti-Aging Anti-Aging

# What Is the Time Machine Procedure™? A Dermatologist Explains

Why I built one plan to treat every sign of aging at once, and what patients can expect.

**By[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**Published** November 20, 20265 min read

Draft for Dr. Tess's review before launch

**On this page**

  1. Why treat everything at once
  2. What goes into a Time Machine plan
  3. Natural, not different
  4. What to expect
  5. FAQ
  6. Sources



**Key takeaways**

  * The Time Machine Procedure™ is a non-surgical plan that treats sun damage, wrinkles, sagging, lost volume and overactive expression lines together.
  * Every plan is personal, built from the treatments that fit your skin and schedule.
  * Many patients say they look 5 to 10 years younger, with natural results.



## Why treat everything at once

Aging does not happen in one place. Sun damage changes the color and quality of the skin, collagen loss brings lines and sagging, the cheeks and under-eyes lose volume, and the muscles we use to frown and squint deepen the creases. Treating only one of those can leave the others looking out of place. That is why I created the Time Machine Procedure™: one plan that addresses every factor together.2

## What goes into a Time Machine plan

There is no single recipe. After looking at your skin, we combine treatments such as injectables for lines and volume, radiofrequency and laser energy for texture and firmness, light-based treatments for spots and redness, and regenerative options when they fit. The aim is total rejuvenation, more complete than the tightening of loose skin that comes from a face lift.

Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Natural, not different

I want you to look like yourself on your best day, not like someone else. As I told _Entertainment Tonight_ , consistent, appropriate maintenance can keep your skin glowing through the years without surgery.3 NBC's _California Live_ called the result a "Benjamin Button effect."1

## What to expect

  1. **Consultation.** We talk about your goals, your skin and your schedule.
  2. **A personal plan.** The combination of treatments that fits you.
  3. **Treatment.** Non-surgical, so most people go back to their routine quickly.
  4. **Maintenance.** A simple plan to keep results going.



## FAQ

Is the Time Machine Procedure™ a face lift?

No. It is non-surgical. It treats skin quality, lines, volume and sagging together without a scalpel.

How long do results last?

It depends on your skin and your maintenance plan. Your consultation covers what to expect.

## Related

[Learn about this treatment](/mbeauty/treatments/time-machine-procedure/)[More articles](/mbeauty/articles/)

  2. [M Beauty Clinic, The Time Machine Procedure](https://www.mbeautyclinic.com/time%20machine%20procedure.htm)

# Botox vs. Filler: Which One Do You Need? | Dr. Tess Mauricio

Source: https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/articles/botox-vs-filler/
Updated: 2026-11-20

[M Beauty Clinic](/mbeauty/)  ›  [Articles](/mbeauty/articles/)  ›  Injectables Injectables

# Botox vs. Filler: Which One Do You Need?

They do different jobs. Here is how to tell which line, fold or hollow calls for which.

**By[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**Published** November 20, 20265 min read

Draft for Dr. Tess's review before launch

**On this page**

  1. How Botox works
  2. How filler works
  3. Which one do you need?
  4. Choose an experienced injector
  5. FAQ
  6. Sources



**Key takeaways**

  * Botox and other neurotoxins relax muscles, so they soften lines that appear when you move your face.
  * Fillers add volume, so they help with hollows, folds and thinning lips.
  * Botox usually lasts three to four months. Fillers can last from months to a couple of years, depending on the product.
  * Many faces benefit from both, used together.



## How Botox works

Botox is a neuromodulator. It blocks the nerve signals that tell certain facial muscles to contract.1 Lines between the brows and crow's feet come from those repeated movements, so relaxing the muscle softens the line. Results start within days, build to their full effect over several weeks, and usually last three to four months.2

## How filler works

Fillers restore fullness where it has been lost: the cheeks, the folds from the nose to the mouth, under the eyes and the lips. Hyaluronic acid fillers such as Juvederm and Voluma are made of a substance found naturally in the skin. Depending on the product, results can last from a few months to a few years.3

Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Which one do you need?

  * **Lines that show when you frown, squint or raise your brows:** usually Botox.
  * **Lines that are there even when your face is still:** often filler, sometimes both.
  * **Flat cheeks, hollow under-eyes or thin lips:** filler.
  * **A heavy or square jaw:** Botox for jaw slimming.



Filler is not the answer to every concern. When it is right for the patient and placed artistically, it can be powerful.4

## Choose an experienced injector

Overfilling and other complications can happen when fillers are injected by someone without the right training.1 Ask who will treat you, what their training is and what product they will use.

## FAQ

Can I get Botox and filler at the same visit?

Often, yes. Many plans use both, since they solve different problems.

Which lasts longer?

Filler usually lasts longer than Botox, but it depends on the product and the area.

## Related

[Learn about this treatment](/mbeauty/treatments/botox-and-fillers/)[More articles](/mbeauty/articles/)

## Sources

  2. [UPMC HealthBeat, "How Long Do Botox and Fillers Last?"](https://share.upmc.com/2025/04/botox-filler-dissolve/)
  3. [UPMC HealthBeat, "Botox and Fillers"](https://share.upmc.com/2024/05/botox-fillers/)
  4. [Entertainment Tonight, "Celebrity Dermatologist Dr. Tess Mauricio Wants You to Look Like Your Best Self, Not Someone Else"](https://www.etonline.com/celebrity-dermatologist-dr-tess-mauricio-wants-you-to-look-like-your-best-self-not-someone-else)

# ALMI Fat Transfer: Using Your Own Fat as a Natural Filler | Dr. Tess Mauricio

Source: https://proposals.localairegistry.com/mbeauty/articles/almi-fat-transfer-natural-filler/
Updated: 2026-11-20

[M Beauty Clinic](/mbeauty/)  ›  [Articles](/mbeauty/articles/)  ›  Regenerative Regenerative

# ALMI Fat Transfer: Using Your Own Fat as a Natural Filler

How a small amount of your own fat can restore volume, and who it suits.

**By[Tess Mauricio, MD, FAAD](/mbeauty/dr-tess-mauricio/)**Board-certified dermatologist * Founder, M Beauty Clinic

**Published** November 20, 20264 min read

Draft for Dr. Tess's review before launch

**On this page**

  1. What fat transfer is
  2. How ALMI differs
  3. Who it suits
  4. When you see results
  5. FAQ
  6. Sources



**Key takeaways**

  * Fat transfer moves a small amount of your own fat to areas that have lost volume, so it works as a natural filler.
  * ALMI is a regenerative fat transfer approach done under local anesthesia.
  * Results develop gradually, and the full picture can take several months.



## What fat transfer is

Fat grafting takes fat from one area of the body and places it where the face has lost volume. Because it uses your own tissue, the American Society of Plastic Surgeons describes it as a natural, autologous filler.1

## How ALMI differs

ALMI harvests fat with local anesthesia and uses the regenerative activity of fat tissue for volume. I am proud to be one of the developers and pioneers of the procedure.2 Patients stay awake and avoid general anesthesia.

Find out which treatment fits your skin.

Consultations in Beverly Hills, San Diego and Chula Vista.

[Book a Consultation](/mbeauty/contact/)

## Who it suits

Fat transfer can suit people with volume loss in the cheeks, temples or under the eyes, including after significant weight loss. If volume loss comes with sagging skin, other treatments may be needed as well.1

## When you see results

The treated areas look softer and fuller, but an accurate picture of your results can take several months.3

## FAQ

Is ALMI the same as filler?

It does a similar job, restoring volume, but uses your own fat instead of a manufactured product.

Does it hurt?

ALMI is done under local anesthesia, so the treated areas are numbed.

## Related

[Learn about this treatment](/mbeauty/treatments/almi-regenerative-medicine/)[More articles](/mbeauty/articles/)

## Sources

  1. [American Society of Plastic Surgeons, "Beyond filler: How fat grafting restores the face after GLP-1 weight loss"](https://www.plasticsurgery.org/news/articles/beyond-filler-how-fat-grafting-restores-the-face-after-glp-1-weight-loss)
  2. [The Aesthetic Guide, profile of Tess Mauricio, MD](https://www.theaestheticguide.com/node/4702)
  3. [The Aesthetic Society, "How long will my fat transfer results last?"](https://prod.theaestheticsociety.org/procedures/body/fat-transfer/results)
